source: បច្ចេកទេស ដាំដុះដំណាំដំឡូងជ្វា (Sweet Potato Cultivation Techniques), MAFF General Directorate of Agriculture, 2018
text:
For planting, farmers should select vine cuttings from healthy vines, taking the middle-to-mature portion of the vine rather than the very young growing tip or overly old, hardened sections. Cuttings should be several internodes in length. Vines showing signs of disease or weak growth should not be used; only pest- and disease-free vines should be selected.

Cuttings are typically cut a few days before planting and allowed to wilt slightly before being planted, which the source states helps the cutting establish well after planting and supports good tuber formation.
